scope: Audit whether installed OpenClaw Core can provide non-LLM-forgeable current Feishu message provenance to the existing local MCP consumer. Only if the audit proves that capability may this request add a local trusted-command envelope integration and offline tests. Otherwise publish the strict unavailable decision and stop.

serial_gate.phase_a: Installed Core Feishu event, router, and MCP context evidence must establish a trusted current-message/current-turn binding before any source or test implementation.
serial_gate.phase_h: Independent review 052A is permitted only when phase G concludes P0_MEDIA_TICKET_FLOW_REMEDIATED and READY_FOR_R3_IMAGE_INDEPENDENT.

implementation_condition: Local source and test changes are forbidden unless the installed Core audit demonstrates a non-forgeable current Feishu message and current execution binding available at the local MCP boundary without OpenClaw Core or Binding modification.
prohibited_actions: OpenClaw core source or Binding modification
Gateway or Core consumer restart, stop, or lifecycle action
Agent, Cron, OAuth, Runtime, model, configuration, P0 gate, P0_READY, or PROJECT_STATUS.yaml change
real Feishu message, attachment, Analyzer invocation, R3, R4, or R5
Reply, card, slash-command, synthetic-command, Project Gateway, session-archive, or latest-session fallback route
commit, push, tag, or deletion of historical evidence
acceptance: Trusted provenance is evidenced as runtime-owned and non-forgeable, or the exact CORE_BINDING_TRUSTED_COMMAND_PROVENANCE_UNAVAILABLE outcome is published.
When capability exists, the MCP consumer must reject caller-supplied provenance and compare the model command against the trusted current message before any Analyzer dispatch.
When capability does not exist, the risk decision presents only the two user-specified choices and makes no implementation claim.
All evidence distinguishes static source inspection, offline tests, and unperformed live validation.
rollback: All permitted changes are project-local documentation, tests, and conditional offline source only. No runtime or production mutation is authorized; reverting the scoped files restores the prior state.
secrets: Do not read, emit, persist, or derive values from protected credential stores, configuration secrets, Feishu payloads, or Codex session archives.
